name: Canvas
description: Canvas, a Folia fork, with Minecraft version selection and an atomic boot updater using the official v2 API. Requires Java 25+; plugins must support Folia/Canvas. The API provides no checksum.
author: tommasobenatti@users.noreply.github.com

installation.content:
#!/bin/ash
set -eu
apk add --no-cache curl jq unzip
cd /mnt/server
update_canvas() {
  command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
    echo "[Canvas Updater] ERROR: curl, jq and unzip must be installed." >&2
    return 1
  }
  version="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-26.2}"
  printf '%s' "$version" | jq -Re 'test("^(latest|[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+){1,2})$")' >/dev/null || return 1
  case "${INCLUDE_EXPERIMENTAL:-0}" in
    1|true) experimental=true ;;
    *) experimental=false ;;
  esac
  api="https://canvasmc.io/api/v2/builds/latest?project=canvas&experimental=$experimental"
  if [ "$version" != "latest" ]; then api="$api&channel=$version"; fi
  build_json=$(curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 120 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" "$api") || {
    echo "[Canvas Updater] ERROR: unable to fetch API metadata for Minecraft $version." >&2
    return 1
  }
  build_json=$(printf '%s' "$build_json" | jq -ec --arg version "$version" --argjson experimental "$experimental" 'select(.result == "SUCCESS" and (.isExperimental == false or ($experimental and .isExperimental == true)) and ($version == "latest" or .channelVersion == $version))') || {
    echo "[Canvas Updater] ERROR: API returned no usable build for Minecraft $version (experimental=$experimental). Check the version; alpha/beta builds require INCLUDE_EXPERIMENTAL=1." >&2
    return 1
  }
  version=$(printf '%s' "$build_json" | jq -er '.channelVersion | select(type == "string" and test("^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+){1,2}$"))') || return 1
  build=$(printf '%s' "$build_json" | jq -er '.buildNumber | select(type == "number" and . > 0 and floor == .)') || return 1
  url=$(printf '%s' "$build_json" | jq -er '.downloadUrl | select(type == "string")') || return 1
  case "$url" in
    "https://jenkins.canvasmc.io/job/Canvas/$build/artifact/canvas-server/build/libs/canvas-build.$build.jar") ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
  release="$version-$build"
  current=$(cat .canvas-build 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ "$current" = "$release" ] && [ -s "$jar" ]; then
    echo "[Canvas Updater] Minecraft $version build $build is already installed."
    return 0
  fi
  echo "[Canvas Updater] Downloading Canvas for Minecraft $version, build $build..."
  echo "[Canvas Updater] $url"
  curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 300 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" -o "$jar.download" "$url" || return 1
  # Canvas publishes no checksum; check archive integrity before replacing the working JAR.
  unzip -tq "$jar.download" >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
  mv -f "$jar.download" "$jar" || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$release" > .canvas-build || return 1
  echo "[Canvas Updater] Canvas $release installed; JAR archive integrity checked."
}
jar="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
case "$jar" in
  .*|-*|*[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*|"") echo "[Canvas Installer] ERROR: invalid JAR filename."; exit 1 ;;
esac
mkdir -p .pterodactyl
cat > .pterodactyl/canvas-start.sh <<'PTERO_CANVAS_START'

    return 1
  }

    return 1

  build=$(printf '%s' "$build_json" | jq -er '.buildNumber | select(type == "number" and . > 0 and floor == .)') || return 1

    return 0
  fi

  echo "[Canvas Updater] $url"
  curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 300 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" -o "$jar.download" "$url" || return 1

}
jar="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
case "$jar" in
  .*|-*|*[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*|"") echo "[Canvas Updater] ERROR: invalid JAR filename."; exit 1 ;;
esac
auto_update="${AUTO_UPDATE:-1}"
if [ "$auto_update" = "1" ] || [ "$auto_update" = "true" ]; then
  if ! update_canvas; then
    rm -f "$jar.download"
    if [ ! -s "$jar" ]; then echo "[Canvas Updater] ERROR: update failed and no runnable JAR exists."; exit 1; fi
    echo "[Canvas Updater] WARNING: update failed; starting the existing JAR."
  fi
else
  echo "[Canvas Updater] Automatic updates are disabled."
  if [ ! -s "$jar" ]; then echo "[Canvas Updater] ERROR: $jar does not exist."; exit 1; fi
fi
exec java ${JAVA_FLAGS:--Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=95.0 -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled --add-modules=jdk.incubator.vector} -Dterminal.jline=false -Dterminal.ansi=true -jar "$jar" --nogui
PTERO_CANVAS_START
chmod 755 .pterodactyl/canvas-start.sh
if ! update_canvas; then
  rm -f "$jar.download"
  echo "[Canvas Installer] ERROR: unable to install Canvas."
  exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
  curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" -o server.properties "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs/main/minecraft/java/server.properties" || true
fi

variables.name: Canvas / Minecraft Version
variables.description: Minecraft version to track, for example 26.2 or 1.21.11. Use latest to follow the newest permitted version. Alpha/beta versions such as 26.3 require Include Experimental Builds = 1. Each boot logs the version, build number and exact download URL.

variables.name: Server JAR File
variables.description: JAR filename used by the updater and startup command.

variables.name: Update on Boot
variables.description: Download the latest permitted Canvas build for the selected Minecraft version at boot. Failed downloads preserve the existing JAR. ZIP integrity is checked; Canvas publishes no checksum.

variables.name: JVM Flags
variables.description: JVM flags with Pterodactyl-aware memory sizing and Canvas's recommended vector module. Requires Java 25 or newer.

variables.name: Include Experimental Builds
variables.description: Set to 1 to permit alpha/beta Canvas builds (required for Minecraft 26.3 while it is experimental). Set to 0 to use stable builds only.
